sources.title: An agentic-AI method for 2D legacy to 3D CAD model reconstruction
sources.snippet: This study proposes an Agentic AI [20] approach to address the limitations of current AI-based methods for 3D CAD reconstruction. By leveraging the content-generation and reasoning capabilities of LLMs, it enables autonomous reconstruction of 3D CAD models from 2D legacy designs with multimodal auxiliary information.

sources.title: An agentic-AI method for 2D legacy to 3D CAD model reconstruction
sources.snippet: This study proposes an Agentic AI [20]approach to address the limitations of current AI-based methods for 3D CAD reconstruction (Table 1). By leveraging the content-generation and reasoning capabilities of LLMs, it enables autonomous reconstruction of 3D CAD models from 2D legacy designs with multimodal auxiliary information.
